messages:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT triggered for customer Aurora Corp (dedicated-pool: aurora-prod-pool) — possible unredacted PII surfaced in VPC logs during autoscale failover. Paging oncall SRE @raj. Priority: P1. Impact: potential exposure in internal logs only (no public endpoints), customers may request notification.

Raj Patel: acked. looking. can someone paste the offending log snippet? also tagging @priya_shah for legal.

Alice Gomez: pasting minimal snippet — this came from the log-forwarder during failover at 23:07 UTC and shows user identifiers not redacted:

Alice Gomez: ```
2025-09-14T23:07:12.453Z INFO request_id=abcd1234 user_email=jane.doe@aurora.com user_ssn=987-65-4321 action=login_success pool=aurora-prod-pool
```

Alice Gomez: yes, that's real PII. forwarder appears to have missed redaction rule for that tenant due to an env var mismatch after the rollout.

Ben Lin: @raj @alice FYI I've already pinged the Aurora security contact (sec-alerts@aurora.com). They asked for immediate mitigation and to confirm whether logs were exported outside their VPC.

Raj Patel: quick triage notes — 1) check if any external sinks received these logs (s3, datadog exports) 2) rotate any keys that touched the forwarder 3) temporarily restrict retention/visibility for that flow. @marta can you take s3 listing?

Marta Orlov: on it. running `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-aurora-prod-logs/ --recursive --human-readable --summarize --profile aurora-prod` now.

Marta Orlov: result: no external export buckets found. last push to s3 was 2025-09-14T22:58Z (pre-failover). only internal ELK index contains 23:07 window.

Priya Shah: legal here. two things: 1) we cannot retain unredacted PII longer than necessary. we need a documented redaction-exception approval if forensics require preserving the raw logs. 2) we must minimize access surface and document all viewers. Please prepare a minimal scope request (who needs access, why, retention window).

Raj Patel: proposed immediate actions:
- apply runtime redaction rule to the forwarder (hotfix)
  ```bash
  curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/forwarders/aurora-prod" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"redaction_rules": ["email","ssn"]}'
  ```
- roll the forwarder single-instance to pick up config (canary first)
- set ELK index to read-only and reduce retention to 24h pending legal approval
- rotate forwarder service account keys and revoke prior tokens

Ben Lin: I've drafted a customer note template for Aurora — holding on send until we confirm containment and legal guidance.

Priya Shah: we will accept a redaction-exception for 72 hours for targeted forensic analysis if all mitigations are in place and access is logged. condition: only infra+security+assigned Aurora contacts may access. legal needs dataset hash and JIRA link.

Raj Patel: creating JIRA INC-2025-aurora-log-pii with triage + audit checklist. assigning to infra oncall.

DeployBot: rollout started for forwarder hotfix (canary: node-7). status: in-progress.

Marta Orlov: canary returned clean — redaction rules applied and new logs show masked fields: `user_email=***@aurora.com user_ssn=***-**-****`.

Raj Patel: good. next steps for me before handoff:
- confirm ELK read-only + retention set to 24h
- upload minimal evidence (hashes) to JIRA and send to @priya for approval of 72h exception
- rotate keys and post audit list in JIRA
- prepare customer-facing message (CS review)

Raj Patel: handing off to night oncall Marta at 00:30 UTC. Marta — please monitor for any other unredacted entries and don't expand retention until Priya approves. logging of who accesses the index is mandatory.

Marta Orlov: ack, taking over. I'll keep the thread updated. leaving a short handoff note:
- current state: forwarder hotfix applied, canary OK, ELK restricted, keys rotated
- outstanding: legal exception approval + final CS message
- contact: Ben Lin (CS), Priya Shah (Legal), Raj Patel (oncall/triage)

Priya Shah: receipt acknowledged. please add the dataset hash + minimal justification to JIRA and escalate to compliance if Aurora pushes for notification.

Ben Lin: once Priya confirms, I'll send the customer note and schedule a follow-up.

Raj Patel: closing the active page from my side. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. will re-open if new findings. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2025-aurora-log-pii status updated to "mitigated" by Raj Patel.

Marta Orlov: noted. I'll post a final summary in the morning and attach the audit trail.

(Reaction summary: +3 :thumbsup: from infra, :eyes: from security)
